dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible on the dorsal surface. The rings consist of a high-intensity white outer boundary enclosing a darker interior that is slightly lighter than the base dark-grey coat. The geometry is predominantly circular with irregular, serrated outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate density of solid white pixel clusters located primarily on the caudal-dorsal section. These clusters are non-geometric, lacking internal gradients, and measure approximately 2 to 4 pixels in diameter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle with the vertex pointed towards the ventral midline. The spatial distance between the neck-region annulus and the mid-dorsal annulus is approximately double the distance between the two posterior-most primary rings.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique clover-shaped configuration of four small annuli is clustered together on the lower posterior-lateral region, forming a composite pattern distinct from the larger isolated rings.
